_comment: Manual website overrides for etl/discover_hospital_sites.py. Keys are CMS CCNs (data/cms/hospitals.json cmsProviderId). Value: a list of website URLs (strings) or objects {"url": "https://...", "note": "why"}. An entry here REPLACES the discovered candidates for that CCN; an empty list suppresses them. The ingest still requires a strict cms-hpt.txt location-name match before attaching any price.
